source.title: Cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neuron tracing reveals structural and functional connectivity for locomotion in the mouse spinal cord
source.citation: Nakamura Y, Kurabe M, Matsumoto M, et al. eLife. 2023;12:e83108.

biologicalScope.spinalContext: Cervical spinal cord around the central canal and subependymal axon bundle
biologicalScope.preparation: Pkd2l1-Cre mice injected at 6 weeks with AAV-Syn-DIO-SYP-HRP or AAV-Syn-DIO-COX4-dAPEX2; tissue collected four weeks later

video.label: Video 5
video.title: Serial section serial block-face scanning electron microscopy images of cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons and the subependymal axon bundle around the central canal.

observedClaims: The publication video exposes serial SBF-SEM image frames of labelled mouse spinal CSF-contacting neurons and the subependymal axon bundle.
The accompanying article reports a reconstruction delineating apical dendritic bulbs, short dendritic structures, basal axons and presynaptic contacts in this experiment.
COX4-dAPEX2 and SYP-HRP label mitochondria and synaptic vesicles respectively at experiment level. A rendered video frame does not provide object masks or coordinates for those compartments.

availabilityAudit.finding: Neither the official article availability statement nor the article API exposes a coordinate-bearing raw SBF-SEM stack, segmentation-label object, reconstruction mesh or skeleton.
articleApiAssetsReviewed: Figure 2, Figure 3 and Figure 7 source-data files exposed by the article API

hardBoundaries: Video pixels may be viewed as publication imagery but may not be converted into cell, membrane, nucleus, organelle, synapse or neurite geometry by this release.
The video is not linked to the Crozat PKD2L1 record, a NeuroMorpho record, MICrONS or any selected molecular profile at same-cell or same-specimen level.
Pseudo-colour and a published rendered reconstruction are presentation layers, not downloadable segmentation masks or coordinate-bearing objects.
No frame interpolation, photogrammetry, depth estimation, segmentation inference, tracing, measurement or atlas registration is admitted.
Failure to load the remote stream leaves the reference unavailable and creates zero fallback primitives.
